title: caroxylon littoralis
intro: Caroxylon littoralis, commonly known as the coastal saltwort or sea purslane, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Amaranthaceae family. The health benefits of Caroxylon littoralis include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Caroxylon littoralis include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Caroxylon littoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
